map.name: Gorrow
map.trouble: Vorgul the Marsh Lord and his Mudmen rise out of the bog to raid the walks, and the Captain has sent the player to Gorrow to learn what Vorgul is up to

guard_bark.specifics: Thoss, the guard at the landing gate of Gorrow, where the Mudmen have lately crept under the walks

first.speaker: Thoss
first.text: Onto the boards, stranger! Enjoy your stay!

again.speaker: Thoss
again.text: You let a few Mudmen frighten you!? You're useless! Now go home! You sicken me!

later.speaker: Thoss
later.text:
Stop right there, stranger! Gwoll swears the Mudmen are creeping under the south walk and the claw marks on the posts prove it.

Let's go! I've got a damp and snug shelter set aside for you.

Will you come quietly, stranger?

bounty_offer.specifics: Dorrit, whose ducks were dragged off from the hamlet of Tarn by Bog Gators, wants them driven out

offer.speaker: Dorrit
offer.text:
Sir! Please help me! A pack of foul Bog Gators just overran Tarn, the hamlet south of here and dragged off almost all of my ducks! One of them was my sweet Pru!

Please drive them out and I promise you a reward!

reminder.speaker: Dorrit
reminder.text: Oh why aren't you going? My poor ducks are in terrible danger!

completion.speaker: Dorrit
completion.text: Oh, thank you, brave sir! These are tokens of my gratitude!

journal.text: Drive the Bog Gators out of Tarn for Dorrit.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Mayor Pellan's amulet, stolen by the Mud Imps, who took it into the sinkhole south of Gorrow

offer.speaker: Pellan
offer.text:
Welcome to Gorrow, noble Adventurer! We've been expecting you!

The Mud Imps who live below the walks have gone wild! They crept up the posts and stole my Amulet! A Hunter chased the little brutes into the sinkhole, but hasn't come back.

Will you go into the sinkhole to the South and recover my Amulet from the Imps? Come see me once you are back. I'll be home on the big platform.

refusal.speaker: Pellan
refusal.text: Oh, bah! Then the Imps can keep it!

reminder.speaker: Pellan
reminder.text: Those pesky Imps are up to no good again these days.

completion.speaker: Pellan
completion.text:
My Amulet! Thank you, kind sir! All Gorrow is truly thankful for your fine work.

Here, take this as a small gift from the hamlet. The Captain is waiting at the landing. You should visit the shops first, then go and talk to him at once.

after.speaker: Pellan
after.text: There is nothing more I can give you but my gratitude. You ought to find the Captain. He is waiting down at the landing.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Pellan's amulet from the Mud Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Mayor Pellan's amulet from the Mud Imps.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Gorrow: one pestered by leeches, one brushing the player off, one with something on his leg

rumour1.speaker: Yarrin
rumour1.text: Help! The leeches are in my bed!

rumour3.speaker: Tuk
rumour3.text: Blaaargh! Get this thing off my leg!

shop_greeting.specifics: Bidda the innkeeper, Krunk the arms seller, Mirelda of the magic shop

inn.speaker: Bidda
inn.text: You look like you could use a bed, friend.

arms.speaker: Krunk
arms.text: Pssst! Hey! Stranger! Want a blade? Cheapest in the marsh and it was hammered together right here in Gorrow!

magic.speaker: Mirelda
magic.text: Go away, stranger! I don't sell to FROG-KILLERS!

two_givers.specifics: Odo wants the ferry rafts the Mudmen took brought back to the dock; Gubb wants his brother Rudge sneaked out of the stocks past Thoss

offer_a.speaker: Odo
offer_a.text:
Hail, brave Adventurer! The Mudmen have snatched our poor ferry rafts during a ruthless raid!

Will you please tow them back to the dock? If you do, a fine reward awaits you, because the folk of Gorrow cannot cross the water without them!

offer_b.speaker: Gubb
offer_b.text: Hello, friend. Will you be my partner, slip my brother Rudge out of the stocks and lead him to the east dock?

outcome_a.speaker: Odo
outcome_a.text:
It's done then! The rafts are home again!

We must be quick, though. The fog is rising!

The Mudmen took most of our coin. One of those greedy Mudmen left a purse behind. Take it, it's yours!

outcome_b.speaker: Gubb
outcome_b.text: That's a relief to hear. I hope you spend your share wisely, for I fear Thoss is getting suspicious. I heard his boots squeaking a moment ago.

journal_a.text: Bring Odo's stolen rafts back to the dock.

journal_b.text: Sneak Rudge out of the stocks for Gubb.

rescue.specifics: Ketta's pet goose Fergus, who can talk, is trapped on the tipping floor of her shed after the Mudmen chopped the posts

plea.speaker: Ketta
plea.text:
Help, please, kind sir! The Mudmen have chopped away the posts of my shed and my poor goose, Fergus, is stuck on the tipping floor of the back room!

Save him and I'll owe you for life!

reminder.speaker: Ketta
reminder.text: Whatever you find in that shed is yours! Just hurry and save Fergus!

found.speaker: Fergus
found.text: Fine! I'll come with you! Just get me off this tipping floor!

completion.speaker: Ketta
completion.text:
Thank goodness, he's safe! How could I ever thank you enough?!

What's that you say? A heap of gold? Well, if that is what you wish, please take this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Save Fergus the Talking Goose from a flooding hut in Gorrow.

main_opening.specifics: Wend points the player to Gwoll, who sends him into the Sunken Chapel to look for signs of Vorgul and the Mudmen

herald.speaker: Wend
herald.text: Don't lose hope now, stranger, Gwoll knows how to stop the Mudmen!

opening.speaker: Gwoll
opening.text: The entrance to the Sunken Chapel is in the last hut on the walk. See if Vorgul has been there. You'll know. And watch your step. Many of the floors have pits against thieves.

reminder.speaker: Gwoll
reminder.text: Enter the Sunken Chapel, lad! We must know if tales of Vorgul's raids are true. Hurry! Go down into the vaults and see if the Mudmen have already come.

journal.text: Search the Sunken Chapel for signs of Vorgul's doings.
